thig7.3:1.1: Cālā. || satīmatī cakkhumatī bhikkhunī bhāvitindriyā | paṭivijjhiṃ padaṃ santaṃ akāpurisasevitaṃ. || ||
thig7.3:2.1: kiṃ nu jātiṃ na rocesi jāto kāmāni bhuñjati | bhuñjāhi kāmaratiyo māhu pacchānutāpinī. || ||
thig7.3:3.1: jātassa maraṇaṃ hoti hatthapādāna chedanaṃ | {vadhabandhaparikilesaṃ} jāto dukkhaṃ nigacchati. || ||
thig7.3:4.1: atthi Sakyakule jāto sambuddho aparājito | so me dhammam adesesi jātiyā samatikkamaṃ. || ||
thig7.3:5.1: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ | ariyaṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ. || ||
thig7.3:6.1: tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā vihariṃ sāsane ratā | tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thig7.3:7.1: sabbattha vihatā nandi tamokkhandho padālito | evaṃ jānāhi pāpima nihato tvam asi antaka. || ||
